column1: # derivation: the input is stat_rows WHERE id < 0; ids are 1 to 7, so no row
# passes (§1.2). §2.3: no grouping keys over zero rows gives one row, COUNT
# 0 (COUNT(DISTINCT) included) and every other aggregate NULL; §2.11 also
# makes the population statistics NULL over no value. Types: COUNT INT64,
# never NULL (§8.6); AVG, VAR, STDDEV FLOAT64 (§8.5); MEDIAN FLOAT64
# (§8.16); MIN the input's type (§8.7); all but COUNT nullable (§2.3).
# avg_f carries §2.10's float AVG tolerance, as in avg_int_float.
